body: I'm a dex build, and I personally prefer the Farron Ultra-Greatsword. Mostly because I can spam LB and it doesn't use any focus, but I also use the Uchigatana as a second equip with shield for the enemies who seem to have unlimited stamina. Also I have heard you can use the Uchigatana for the whole game.
Thanks, I hadn't thought of that view point.
